claims.value: Photograph (colour); view of petroglyphs of the bird-man on rocks, on top of a cliff, with the sea in the background; Orongo, Easter Island.

notes.text: This British Museum catalogue record describes a photograph by Katesa Schlosser, made in September 1980. It is registered as a documentary source, not as a physical Rapa Nui artefact, and no image is published. Only the complete Description field is extracted; the record identifies the view as Orongo but does not identify individual carvings.
